Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. A standalone `forge test --pytest <base>` starts tests under high load. The new load check runs in `machine.join`, but `src/forge/fasttest.py:269` calls `pytest_tests` directly for this documented picker mode, and `src/forge/fasttest.py:428` launches the test command without joining the lane. The new test exercises only bare `forge test`, so it does not catch this path.
